the disclosed loop model of the BG loop, as presented here, is an attempt to capture the functional logic of cortico-BG connections, and the role of the striatum in the momentary and longer-term selection of actions.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the striatum is a highly integrative structure, and that the functional logic of cortico-BG circuitry can be understood only by considering the striatal volume as a whole, rather than in terms of a few isolated subregions.
